## Clearer questions from the agent

- **You always see what you approve.** Claude Code shortens what the agent writes just before a question, which hid proposed outlines. The agent now puts the outline (readers, folder tree, each page's purpose, landing cards) in the approval question's preview, or ends its turn with it in plain text where previews don't exist.
- **One decision per question**, with short options and the recommended one first.
- **No logo? The agent offers to design one**: a simple square SVG mark, shown to you before it's used.

## Fixes

- A page without its own `# heading` now shows its frontmatter `title` as the heading, like Docusaurus.

## Also

- The README opens with a recording of Claude Code documenting a real project with indoc.
- New docs pages: [Supported languages and frameworks](https://byabasaija.github.io/indoc/reference/support/) and [FAQ](https://byabasaija.github.io/indoc/concepts/faq/).
- Issue forms, a pull request template, CONTRIBUTING.md, and [Discussions](https://github.com/byabasaija/indoc/discussions).

### Upgrading

Nothing to change. Update the plugin to get the new questions.
